explanation_en: Wicket! WP Saha is caught off SP Narine's bowling. Your Vice-Captain SP Narine gets a massive 25.0 raw points, which becomes 37.5 points after the 1.5x multiplier, taking your total from 81.0 to 118.5 and boosting your rank by 2123 spots from 2777 to 654!
explanation_hi: Wicket! WP Saha out ho gaye SP Narine ki ball pe. Apne Vice-Captain SP Narine ko mile pure 25.0 points, jo 1.5x multiplier ke baad ban gaye 37.5 points, aur apni team ka total 81.0 se seedha 118.5 ho gaya, rank bhi 2777 se 654 pe chadh gayi, boss, 2123 spots ka jump!
watch_next_en: Shubman Gill needs 20 more runs for his 30-run milestone bonus.
watch_next_hi: Shubman Gill ko abhi 20 runs aur chahiye 30-run milestone bonus ke liye.
